plain: I bought a vacuum cleaner from your website on March 12 and it arrived with a cracked handle. I contacted your support team the same day and sent photos, but they told me damage in transit isn't covered. That's not acceptable, since the item was clearly packed badly. I want a replacement or a full refund of $249 within 10 days. If I don't hear from you by then, I'll raise a chargeback with my bank and report you to consumer protection.
legal: On March 12, I purchased a vacuum cleaner from your website, and it was delivered with a cracked handle. I contacted your support team on the same day and provided photographs, but I was informed that damage in transit is not covered. This position is not acceptable, as the item was evidently packed inadequately. I hereby demand either a replacement or a full refund of $249 within ten (10) days. Should I not receive a response from you within that period, I shall initiate a chargeback through my bank and report the matter to the relevant consumer protection authority.

plain: Hi, I'm the tenant at flat 4B. The boiler has been broken for 3 weeks and I've reported it to you five times by email. I have a baby at home and we've had no hot water or heating. If it isn't repaired by Friday, I'll get it fixed myself and take the cost off next month's rent of $1,350. Please reply to this email to confirm what you're doing.
legal: I am the tenant of flat 4B. The boiler has been inoperative for three (3) weeks, and I have reported the defect to you by email on five (5) occasions. I have an infant at home, and we have been without hot water or heating. If the boiler is not repaired by Friday, I shall arrange for the repair myself and deduct the cost thereof from next month's rent of $1,350. Please reply to this email to confirm the steps that you are taking.

plain: I ordered a blender from you on 2 June and it didn't turn on when it arrived. Your customer service agent refused to arrange a replacement and wouldn't give me a refund either. I've kept the box and the receipt. If I don't get a replacement or my money back within 14 days, I'll hand this over to my lawyer and sue you for every penny.
legal: On 2 June, I ordered a blender from you, and it failed to operate upon delivery. Your customer service agent refused to arrange a replacement and further declined to provide a refund. I have retained the original packaging and the receipt. Should I not receive either a replacement or a refund within fourteen (14) days, I shall refer this matter to my lawyer and commence legal proceedings against you for the full amount owed.

plain: We're writing about invoice 2207 for $8,450, which was due on 30 April. We've sent two reminders and haven't had any reply. Our contract says late payments carry 2% interest per month, and we'll start charging that from today. If the full amount isn't paid by 31 May, we'll stop all work on your project and pass the debt to our lawyers.
legal: We write in respect of invoice number 2207 in the sum of $8,450, which fell due on 30 April. We have issued two (2) reminders and have received no response. Pursuant to our contract, late payments bear interest at the rate of 2% per month, and we shall apply such interest with effect from today. If the full amount is not paid by 31 May, we shall suspend all work on your project and refer the debt to our lawyers.

plain: Dear neighbour, the tree on your side of the fence has dropped branches onto our shed twice this winter. The last one put a hole in the roof, and the repair quote is $640. We've asked you three times to have the tree trimmed. Please have it trimmed within 21 days and pay for the shed repair. If you won't, we'll have to take this further.
legal: Dear neighbour, the tree situated on your side of the fence has dropped branches onto our shed on two (2) occasions this winter. The most recent branch caused a hole in the roof, and the quotation for the repair is $640. We have requested on three (3) occasions that you have the tree trimmed. We request that you have the tree trimmed within twenty-one (21) days and bear the cost of the repair to the shed. Should you fail to do so, we shall have no alternative but to pursue this matter further.

plain: I'm writing to cancel my internet contract, account number 55190. I moved house on 15 August and you can't provide service at my new address, which your own staff confirmed on the phone. Under your terms, I can cancel without a fee if you can't serve my address. Please close the account, stop all direct debits and send me written confirmation to j.wong@example.net.
legal: I hereby give notice of the cancellation of my internet contract, account number 55190. I relocated on 15 August, and you are unable to provide service at my new address, as your own staff confirmed by telephone. Pursuant to your terms, I am entitled to cancel without incurring a fee where you are unable to provide service at my address. Please close the account, cease all direct debits and send written confirmation to me at j.wong@example.net.

plain: To whoever is in charge: your delivery driver reversed into my gate on Monday and drove off without leaving a note. My doorbell camera recorded the whole thing, including the van's number plate. The gate will cost $1,100 to replace. I expect your company to pay for it in full, and I want a reply within 7 days.
legal: To the person responsible: on Monday, your delivery driver reversed into my gate and departed without leaving any note. My doorbell camera recorded the entire incident, including the registration plate of the van. The cost of replacing the gate is $1,100. I expect your company to bear that cost in full, and I require a response within seven (7) days.

plain: We've decided to end our partnership with your agency at the end of this quarter, on 30 September. The decision is because of repeated missed deadlines, not because of the quality of the creative work. We'll pay all invoices for work delivered up to that date. Please hand over all files, passwords and campaign data by 7 October.
legal: We hereby give notice that we shall terminate our partnership with your agency at the end of the current quarter, on 30 September. This decision arises from repeated failures to meet deadlines and not from the quality of the creative work. We shall pay all invoices in respect of work delivered up to that date. You are required to deliver to us all files, passwords and campaign data by 7 October.

plain: I want to make a formal complaint about the treatment I got at your clinic on 11 February. I waited 4 hours past my appointment time and nobody told me why. When I asked, the receptionist was rude and told me to go home. I'd like a written apology and a refund of the $90 consultation fee.
legal: I wish to lodge a formal complaint regarding the treatment that I received at your clinic on 11 February. I waited four (4) hours beyond my appointment time, and no explanation was provided to me. When I enquired, the receptionist was discourteous and instructed me to leave. I request a written apology and a refund of the consultation fee of $90.

plain: Look, I've been patient. You promised the kitchen would be done in 6 weeks and it's now been 14. Half the cabinets are missing, the sink isn't connected and your crew hasn't shown up since last Tuesday. Either finish the job by the end of the month or give me back the $9,000 I paid for work that hasn't been done.
legal: I have exercised considerable patience. You undertook to complete the kitchen within six (6) weeks, and fourteen (14) weeks have now elapsed. Half of the cabinets are missing, the sink has not been connected, and your crew has not attended since last Tuesday. You are required either to complete the work by the end of the month or to refund to me the sum of $9,000 that I paid for work that has not been performed.

plain: My name is Daniel Okafor and I worked at your restaurant from January to June. My final paycheck was meant to include 40 hours of overtime and 5 days of unused holiday, but neither was paid. I've asked the manager twice and got no answer. Please pay what I'm owed within 14 days, or I'll file a complaint with the labour authority.
legal: My name is Daniel Okafor, and I was employed at your restaurant from January to June. My final payment of wages was required to include forty (40) hours of overtime and five (5) days of unused holiday entitlement, but neither has been paid. I have raised this with the manager on two (2) occasions and have received no response. Please pay the amounts owed to me within fourteen (14) days, failing which I shall file a complaint with the competent labour authority.

plain: We, the residents of Maple Court, are writing about the lift that has been out of order since 3 March. Several of us are elderly or use wheelchairs and haven't been able to leave our flats. You're responsible for maintaining the lift under our leases. We ask that it's repaired within 7 days and that you tell us in writing when the work will happen.
legal: We, the residents of Maple Court, write regarding the lift, which has been out of service since 3 March. Several of us are elderly or use wheelchairs and have been unable to leave our flats. You are responsible for the maintenance of the lift under the terms of our leases. We request that the lift be repaired within seven (7) days and that you notify us in writing of the date on which the work shall be carried out.

plain: honestly fed up. your app charged me $19.99 three times last month for one subscription and support keeps sending me the same copy-paste reply. I want the two extra charges refunded and I want someone to actually read my emails. if this isn't sorted by next friday I'm reporting you to my bank and leaving a review everywhere I can.
legal: I am dissatisfied with the handling of this matter. Your application charged me $19.99 on three (3) occasions last month for a single subscription, and your support team has repeatedly sent me the same standard reply. I hereby demand a refund of the two (2) duplicate charges and request that my emails receive proper consideration. If this matter is not resolved by next Friday, I shall report it to my bank and publish reviews of my experience wherever possible.

plain: We're pleased to offer you the role of junior accountant starting on 6 January. Your salary will be $52,000 a year, paid monthly. The first 3 months are a probation period, during which either of us can end the employment with 1 week's notice. Please sign and return this letter by 20 December if you accept.
legal: We are pleased to offer you the position of junior accountant, commencing on 6 January. Your salary shall be $52,000 per annum, payable monthly. The first three (3) months of employment shall constitute a probationary period, during which either party may terminate the employment upon one (1) week's notice. If you accept this offer, please sign and return this letter by 20 December.

plain: I'm writing to let you know that I have to pull out of the house purchase. My mortgage offer was withdrawn on 9 September for reasons beyond my control. Under clause 7 of the reservation agreement, I understand I'm entitled to get my $2,500 reservation fee back. Please return it to the account it was paid from within 10 working days.
legal: I write to inform you that I must withdraw from the purchase of the house. My mortgage offer was withdrawn on 9 September for reasons beyond my control. Under clause 7 of the reservation agreement, I understand that I am entitled to the return of my reservation fee of $2,500. Please refund that fee to the account from which it was paid within ten (10) working days.

plain: Thanks for getting back to me. I accept your offer to repair the phone for free, but I don't accept that the 2-week wait is reasonable. I need a phone for work, so please give me a loan phone while mine is with you. If you can't, I'd like the repair done within 5 days instead.
legal: Thank you for your response. I accept your offer to repair the phone free of charge; however, I do not accept that the waiting period of two (2) weeks is reasonable. As I require a phone for work, please provide me with a loan phone while my phone is in your possession. Should you be unable to do so, I request that the repair be completed within five (5) days instead.

plain: You can rent the cabin from Friday at 3pm to Sunday at 11am for $480. You need to pay a $200 deposit, which we'll return within 7 days after you leave if nothing is damaged. No more than 6 guests can stay overnight. Pets aren't allowed, and smoking inside will cost you the whole deposit.
legal: The Guest may rent the Cabin from 3pm on Friday until 11am on Sunday for the sum of $480. The Guest shall pay a deposit of $200, which the Owner shall return within seven (7) days after the Guest's departure, provided that no damage has occurred. No more than six (6) guests shall stay overnight. Pets are not permitted, and smoking inside the Cabin shall result in forfeiture of the entire deposit.

plain: The freelancer will build the online shop in 3 stages. Each stage has to be approved by the client before the next one starts. The client pays $1,500 at the start of each stage. If the client asks for changes after approving a stage, those changes are billed at $60 an hour. Either side can end the project with 14 days' written notice, and the client pays for all completed work.
legal: The Freelancer shall develop the online shop in three (3) stages. Each stage shall be subject to the Client's approval before the next stage commences. The Client shall pay $1,500 at the commencement of each stage. Any changes requested by the Client after approval of a stage shall be charged at the rate of $60 per hour. Either Party may terminate the project upon fourteen (14) days' written notice, in which case the Client shall pay for all work completed.

plain: Employees can work from home up to 2 days a week if their manager agrees. You must be reachable on chat and phone between 10am and 4pm. Company laptops have to stay locked when you're not using them, and you can't let family members use them. If you have a security incident, report it to it-security@acme.example within 1 hour.
legal: Employees may work remotely for up to two (2) days per week, subject to the approval of their manager. Each Employee shall be reachable by chat and telephone between 10am and 4pm. Company laptops shall remain locked when not in use, and Employees shall not permit family members to use them. Any security incident shall be reported to it-security@acme.example within one (1) hour.

plain: Members can bring up to 2 guests per visit, but each guest pays a $15 day fee. Guests have to sign the waiver at the front desk before they use any equipment. Members are responsible for their guests' behaviour. If a guest breaks the rules, the member can lose guest privileges for 3 months.
legal: Each Member may bring up to two (2) guests per visit, provided that each guest pays a day fee of $15. Guests shall sign the waiver at the front desk before using any equipment. Members shall be responsible for the conduct of their guests. If a guest breaches the rules, the Member may forfeit guest privileges for a period of three (3) months.

plain: We collect your name, email and order history so we can process orders and send receipts. We don't sell your data to anyone. We share it only with our payment provider and delivery partners, and only as much as they need. You can ask us to delete your data at any time by emailing privacy@shopline.example, and we'll do it within 30 days unless the law requires us to keep it.
legal: The Company collects the User's name, email address and order history for the purposes of processing orders and issuing receipts. The Company shall not sell the User's data to any person. The Company shall share such data solely with its payment provider and delivery partners, and only to the extent necessary for them. The User may request deletion of the User's data at any time by emailing privacy@shopline.example, and the Company shall effect such deletion within thirty (30) days, unless applicable law requires its retention.

plain: The roommates split rent of $2,100 equally, so each pays $700 by the 1st of the month. Utilities are shared equally too. Overnight guests can't stay more than 3 nights in a row without everyone agreeing. Anyone who wants to move out has to give 30 days' notice and find a replacement the others are happy with, or keep paying their share until someone is found.
legal: The Roommates shall share the rent of $2,100 equally, such that each Roommate shall pay $700 on or before the first (1st) day of each month. Utility costs shall likewise be shared equally. No overnight guest shall stay for more than three (3) consecutive nights without the consent of all Roommates. Any Roommate who wishes to vacate shall give thirty (30) days' notice and shall either find a replacement acceptable to the other Roommates or continue to pay that Roommate's share until a replacement is found.

plain: Tickets aren't refundable, but you can transfer them to someone else up to 48 hours before the event. If we cancel the event, you'll get a full refund within 14 days. If we move it to a new date, you can either keep your ticket or ask for a refund within 7 days of the announcement. We aren't responsible for travel or hotel costs.
legal: Tickets shall not be refundable; however, the Ticket Holder may transfer a ticket to another person up to forty-eight (48) hours before the Event. If the Organizer cancels the Event, the Ticket Holder shall receive a full refund within fourteen (14) days. If the Organizer reschedules the Event, the Ticket Holder may either retain the ticket or request a refund within seven (7) days of the announcement. The Organizer shall not be liable for any travel or accommodation costs.

plain: The seller will deliver 500 units by 15 October. If the goods arrive late, the buyer gets a 1% discount for each day of delay, up to 10%. The buyer has 5 working days after delivery to report defects. Defective units will be replaced at the seller's cost, but the seller isn't liable for any lost profits.
legal: The Seller shall deliver five hundred (500) units on or before 15 October. In the event of late delivery, the Buyer shall be entitled to a discount of 1% for each day of delay, up to a maximum of 10%. The Buyer shall report any defects within five (5) working days after delivery. The Seller shall replace any defective units at the Seller's cost, provided that the Seller shall not be liable for any loss of profits.

plain: Volunteers have to be at least 16 years old. Anyone under 18 needs a parent's signed permission form. Volunteers must wear the club t-shirt during events and can't drink alcohol while on duty. Shifts are 4 hours long, and if you can't make your shift, tell the coordinator at least 24 hours before.
legal: Volunteers shall be not less than sixteen (16) years of age. Any Volunteer under the age of eighteen (18) shall provide a permission form signed by a parent. Volunteers shall wear the club t-shirt during events and shall not consume alcohol while on duty. Each shift shall be four (4) hours in duration, and any Volunteer who is unable to attend a shift shall notify the Coordinator not less than twenty-four (24) hours in advance.
